title: LaGuardia's Missing Controllers, Virgin Atlantic's Route Cuts, and Frontier's Oakland Gamble
summary: New details emerge about the LaGuardia tower on the night an Air Canada CRJ hit a fire truck on the runway, and it's not a good look for the FAA. Plus, Virgin Atlantic quietly guts its long-haul map, Frontier sniffs out opportunity in Oakland now that Southwest's pulled back, and a Denver airport breakup goes about as well as you'd expect.
